timeline.label: Balance sheet shows $1.73B long-term debt and cash down to $471M after acquisition-related financing; net debt weighs on per-share owner-cash value
Annual recurring revenue reached $1.3B as software and sensors mix expands; revenue recognized from contract liabilities was $682M in FY2025
FY2025 owner cash (operating cash flow minus capital spending) was $75M on $2.78B revenue despite 33% top-line growth narrative
Closed Dedrone acquisition, expanding counter-drone and aerial public-safety capabilities
Closed Fusus acquisition, adding real-time crime-center and fusion software to the Axon ecosystem
Realigned reporting into Software and Sensors versus TASER devices to highlight recurring software mix
Rebranded from TASER International to Axon Enterprise to emphasize cloud evidence and public-safety platform strategy

industry.structure: Axon sits at the center of US public-safety technology: less-lethal devices, body cameras, digital evidence management, and dispatch/fusion software. Customer budgets are municipal and federal; switching costs rise once evidence and devices are integrated into Axon Cloud.
industry.share_shift: Axon is gaining share in connected devices and SaaS as agencies consolidate vendors; smaller hardware rivals compete on price while software attach drives wallet share.
industry.trend: Recurring software and annual recurring revenue are growing faster than hardware; acquisitions (Fusus, Dedrone) add drone and real-time operations options. Capex and acquisition debt temporarily compress owner cash versus revenue growth.
